scope: Proposition 6.2 (First contact above a scripted prefix) of the manuscript “A directional zero–one law for finite-range-dependent random environments” (preprints/A-directional-zero-one-law-for-finite-range-dependent-random-environments-October-5-2026/directional-zero-one-finite-range.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 220 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 010edc479fd82038), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 27. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume p+p− > 0, and let M ≤ k < r < N be integers with r − k ≥ R. Start a positive bridge Y with law B+ N at the origin, and put Elat = πYTN . Independently of Y , sample a relative marked path with law b P−, and translate it to start at (N − 1, Elat); denote the resulting path by β. Define τ = inf{i : Tk(Y ) ≤ i < TN (Y ), ∥Yi − βj∥∞ ≤ R for some j ≥ 0}, with inf ∅ = ∞. Let Ck,r,N =    D+ k (Y ), τ < TN (Y ), (Yτ )1 ≥ r, min Tk(Y )≤i≤τ (Yi)1 ≥ k, |Elat| ≤ N2    . (6.4) Here D+ k (Y ) is a condition on the prefix through the first hit of k. There is a constant C, independent of k, r, N, such that, with ∆ = u+ r−k − u+ N−k, P(Ck,r,N ) ≤ C log(2N) ∆ log2 (e/∆). (6.5) The right-hand side is defined to be zero when ∆ = 0.
